origin: Authored in this repository for the M4 ngspice statement and directive grammar
author: xdylanm
notes: One small netlist per group of statements and directives; manual examples are paraphrased. LF, CRLF and mixed line endings, a missing final newline, + and \\ continuations, trailing comments, a nested subcircuit with a default and an override, and a parenthesized multi-line .model. Every file runs in ngspice 47.
